1445-4871-6351-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6351-8227.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2167-3257-4548-5721.easyPrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{B} (but see notes).
2167-3257-4548-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing each land you control, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{B}.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Takenuma from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, milling three cards and returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {1}{G}.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat
2167-3257-4548-5721.notes: Each legendary creature you control reduces the amount of mana required by {1}, up to a maximum of {3}. Each loop also has a chance to generate more mana than the one before it due to additional milled lands, so if you have excess mana you can begin the loop without the required number of lands and have a chance to achieve the infinite loop through milling.

6854-8095--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
6854-8095--5--195.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3899-6972-7936.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2738-4871-5075-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Ogre Slumlord, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4365-4772-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3532-5078-7356-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7356-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

1978-2750-7704.description:
Cause Doc Samson to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4548-4871-5763.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Circle of the Land Druid, adding {1}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability, Pitiless Plunderer and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Circle of the Land Druid trigger, returning Takenuma from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, returning Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Circle of the Land Druid by paying {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters, its first ability triggers, allowing you to mill four cards.
Repeat.

2308-4871-5231-7173.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4871-5231-7173.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Virulent Emissary triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3532-5078--73.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
If the persist or undying creature does not have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing the +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter from the persist or undying creature.
Repeat.

3532-4030-4928-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4030-4928-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5295-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

1409-5361-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
1409-5361-7009.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Auton Soldier by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
When Auton Soldier enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Auton Soldier.
Repeat each turn.

460-539-1008.description:
Activate Undermountain Adventurer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Undermountain Adventurer.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.
460-539-1008.notes: This combo makes infinite green mana if you've completed a dungeon.

1029-4734-5028.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Cradle Clearcutter.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-4734-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

151-2872-5261.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
151-2872-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

891-2034-2386-2579.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2034-2386-2579.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant, adding {C}{C}.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, The Cauldron of Eternity and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

2645-3275-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Swamps.
2645-3275-4657.description:
Cast Bubbling Muck by paying {B}.
Activate five Swamps by tapping them, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Bubbling Muck triggers five times, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five Swamps.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

539-2404-3206-4170.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
539-2404-3206-4170.description:
Activate Manascape Refractor using Gaea's Cradle's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Fain's fourth ability by paying {4}, untapping Manascape Refractor.
Repeat.

253-2749-4591.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving Wall of Blood +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Soul Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, exchanging your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
